Name: More Monsters
Author: ReddishLunar
Description:
[list]
[*][b][size=3]What this mod does[/size][/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿This mod increases monsters [b]quantity[/b] in each floor of t[b]he Mines[/b] and [b]Skull Cavern[/b]. 

﻿ ﻿In vanilla game, a floor in the Mines will only spawn about [b]20-30 monsters[/b] at most. This mod will make each floor in the Mines and Skull Cavern ﻿ ﻿spawn [b]hundreds of monsters[/b]. (Just more [b]quantity[/b]. No new types of monsters.) [b]You can also set a range to let it spawn random amount.[/b]

[list]
[*][b][size=3]Mod Config [/size][/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿Monsters will spawn more by default. If you need more or less quantity of monsters, or you want random quantity, you can set it in config file:

﻿ ﻿"Stardew Valley\Mods\MoreMonsters\config.json": 
[code] ﻿ ﻿{
  ﻿ "MonsterMulty": 0.2,
  ﻿ ﻿"MonsterRandomMulty": 0.001
﻿ ﻿}
[/code]
﻿ ﻿"MonsterMulty" is the spawning rate of monsters. For vanilla game it is 0.002. You can set it to any number between 0 and 1.
﻿ ﻿"MonsterRandomMulty" is extra random spawning rate. The extra rate will random between 0 to the number you set.
﻿ ﻿You need to set it > 0.

﻿ ﻿So the final spawning rate is between MonsterMulty to (MonsterMulty + MonsterRandomMulty).

[list]
[*][size=3][b]Conflictions[/b][/size]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿In theory this mod won't conflict with other combat mods because it only changes one line under SratdewValley.Locations.MineShaft:

[code] ﻿ ﻿private void populateLevel()
﻿ ﻿{
﻿ ﻿// Vanilla line:
﻿ ﻿// double monsterChance = 0.002 + (double)this.mineRandom.Next(200) / 10000.0;
﻿ ﻿// Changed to:
  ﻿ ﻿double monsterChance = MonsterMulty + (double)this.mineRandom.Next(MonsterRandomMulty) / 10000.0;
﻿ ﻿}
[/code]
﻿ ﻿But this mod uses Harmony and hasn't been fully tested for conflictions, so still [b]back up[/b] your save. 

﻿ ﻿Thanks for CatCattyCat's codes on how to use Harmony .
